available.title: Available
available.description: Whether the Kafka broker was reachable for the latest sample.

in_per_sec.title: In Per Sec
in_per_sec.description: Messages entering the system per second (source-topic high watermarks), null until a second sample exists.

out_per_sec.title: Out Per Sec
out_per_sec.description: Messages fully processed and delivered per second (destination committed offsets), null until a second sample exists.
